name: Sunset Bar
creator: Lingie
description: Sunset Bar is a PCVR and Oculus Quest compatible bar/club world published in August 2023, built to support up to around 60 players per instance. It centers on an elaborate drink-making system with customizable alcohol types, colors, and glassware, alongside a DJ and sound system, private rooms, and a video player. The world grew quickly into one of the more visited bar hangouts in VRChat's social scene.
